name: MediPhi-PubMed
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.821 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-05-28. Caveat: the +1.2 pp CLUE+ average is carried by two rows (MEDEC +7.4, RRS QA +2.9); it loses LH, MeDiSumCode and MedicationQA to base. Same CLUE+ table as the existing mediphi/mediphi-clinical/mediphi-instruct records - this is the PubMed expert column, a sibling of those merged models, not a better model than them (MediPhi-Instruct scores 43.4 avg on the same table).
